statements.t: We are evolving our Brand Partner incentive plan to more directly reward growth in active customers, investing in digital marketing to build awareness of the USANA brand, and advancing product innovation that we plan to begin introducing in 2027.
Additionally, Hiya continues to make progress in broadening its reach beyond direct-to-consumer, and we look forward to providing updates in early 2027.
As planned, we launched Protein Pop Balance nationally at Target and online in September, and Target sales grew strongly from the second quarter.
The Company is updating its outlook for fiscal year 2026, as follows:

That financial strength gives us the flexibility to continue investing in the initiatives we expect to drive future growth across our businesses, including our omnichannel strategy, while maintaining financial discipline.
“We are updating our fiscal 2026 outlook to consolidated net sales approaching $900 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $77 million.

Compared with our prior outlook, as corrected, the change reflects lower expectations for Rise Wellness and our deliberate decision to invest resources at Hiya to drive increased active monthly subscribers, partially offset by stronger profitability in Core Nutritional.

While these investments constrain near-term results, we believe they set the stage for renewed growth across our businesses, and we plan to enter 2027 with a strong balance sheet and clear priorities to deliver it.”

In addition, other companies, including companies in our industry, may calculate similarly titled non-GAAP financial measures differently or may use other measures to evaluate their performance, all of which could reduce the usefulness of non-GAAP financial information as a tool for comparison.
